name: Smart 404 Redirect by Puzzle Sideral
author: multiplas

sections.description:
Smart 404 Redirect by Puzzle Sideral helps site owners fix broken URLs without digging through server logs.

The plugin captures public 404 requests, groups repeated hits, and uses a local Smart Match engine to compare the broken URL with your published WordPress content. When it finds a likely match, you can create an internal 301 redirect with one click.

Features:

  • Captures public 404 URLs automatically.
  • Groups repeated hits and shows last referrer when available.
  • Local smart matching based on URL slug, post title, and keywords.
  • One-click internal 301 redirects from the admin screen.
  • Manual redirect target field for edge cases.
  • Simple Witflow-style dashboard with status cards and active rules.

The smart matching runs locally inside WordPress. It does not send URLs or content to external AI providers.

Privacy

This plugin stores broken URL paths, hit counts, timestamps, and the last referrer URL when available. It does not store visitor IP addresses and does not send captured URLs to third-party services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/smart-404-redirect-by-puzzle-sideral directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Smart 404 admin menu and review captured 404 URLs.
  4. Click the suggested redirect button or enter a manual target URL.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use an external AI service?

No. The Smart Match engine is local and uses WordPress content metadata, URL slugs, titles, and simple scoring.

Does it create redirects automatically without review?

No. The plugin proposes redirects, but creating the recommended redirect requires an administrator click.

What redirect status code is used?

The plugin creates 301 redirects for active rules.
